Audit View
A report under Reports. It lists Orders, Invoices and Payments for a date range you pick, first for project data, then for non-project data.
Projects Data / Non Projects Data
The new names of the Report Type choices. They were All Project View / Non Project View; the values in the link stay the same.
Step 1 / Step 2
The Audit View asks for a date range first (step 1), then for a tab: Orders, Invoices or Payments (step 2).
Against
The column that says what a row is for: the PO or WO number, or, for an expense, its description.
ITM
Internal Transfer Memo: material moved into this project from another project or from the warehouse.
DC / MIR
Delivery Challan (the paper that comes with a delivery) and Material Inspection Report (the site's check of what arrived).
DC Wise / MIR Wise
Views of a project's Material Usage tab that list one row per DC or MIR.
DN Qty
Delivery Note quantity: how much of the document's items was received, from the PO or the ITM.
MSME
A small-business registration (Udyam). A vendor's MSME ID and its certificate are kept on the vendor.
TDS
Tax deducted at source: tax held back from a vendor's payment. Net Paid = Amount Paid + TDS.
Before / After
Before is the code the PR starts from (develop at de49cf3c0). After is the PR's own code (e65cc94c0).
Role check
A test that one role sees, or does not see, what the PR says it should.
Must / Should / Nit / Note
How serious a pinned point is: must fix before merge, should fix, small polish, or just worth knowing.
